items.name: El Palmar Cubing Fest 2022

venue.name: Redondel El Palmar
venue.address: XCHM+RMR, C. Centro America, Santa Ana

items.information:
"El Palmar Cubing Fest 2022" sera la segunda  competencia del año 2022 en la ciudad de Santa Ana.

Con protocolos de Bioseguridad nacionales y los establecidos por la WCA, "El Palmar Cubing Fest 2022" busca mantener el desarrollo del speedcubing en El Salvador de la manera mas segura posible.

**-- El uso de mascarilla es opcional dentro de la competencia**
____ 
"El Palmar Cubing Fest 2022" will be the second competition of the year 2022 in the city of Santa Ana.

With national Biosafety protocols and those established by the WCA, "El Palmar Cubing Fest 2022" seeks to maintain the development of speedcubing in El Salvador in the safest way possible.

**- Protective face mask usage is Optional at the competition venue.**

items.name: Sunday Silence Singapore 2022
items.information: While guests are permitted,  we recommend that any accompanying guests should wait in TripleOne Somerset Mall so as to not distract the competitors.  Guests who remain in the venue must remain silent when events are ongoing. Guests and/or competitors that are disruptive may be asked to leave the venue.

items.name: CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2022
items.information:
This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. For a more normal comeptition experience, check out [CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2022).

Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized at [CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2022) during the award ceremony there.

This competition will take place at 3 different venues across the Southeast. Check out the Location Tab for more details.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbTBXIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--61daaa8cd11c06c615d4ebc1afb04c6ef3afbb93/cubing%20logo%20smaller.png)

items.name: Howland Returns 2022
items.information:
We are excited to bring back another Howland Competiton!

Please read the Covid-19 Policies tab to fully understand the health requirements before entering the competiton.

If you are a new competitor, please read the Competitor Info before entering the competiton.

items.name: GA Cubers Warm Up 2022
items.information:
This competition is a special competition with side events; we will not hold 3x3x3. For a more normal competition experience, we recommend checking out [CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2022).

This competition is the same day as [CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2022), which is a multi-location FMC Championship. We recommend checking it out and registering for it as well if you are interested.
